Chapter 1

Rhys looked at me across the table, his eyes dark. Cassian leaned against the wall by the door, his arms crossed. Rhys rubbed his jaw. Cassian shifted his weight.

"You are late," Rhys said.

"I know," I said. "I was busy."

"Busy with what?"

"Painting."

"Since when do you paint at night?"

I shrugged. "Since always."

"Fine," Cassian said. "Then paint us something."

"Maybe later," I said.

"Later then," Rhys said. "Later, always later."
